step.label: Retrieve employee payroll baseline
step.description: Extract current payroll records and compensation data for all active employees to establish the baseline for compensation analysis.
step.useCase: Finance team needs current payroll data to begin the quarterly compensation review cycle.

step.label: Validate organizational hierarchy and reporting structure
step.description: Confirm employee organizational placement, reporting lines, and departmental assignments to ensure compensation decisions align with organizational context.
step.useCase: HR needs to ensure compensation review respects the correct organizational structure and manager approval chains.

step.label: Assess current benefits enrollment status
step.description: Review active benefits elections, coverage levels, and enrollment changes to understand current benefits liabilities and employee participation.
step.useCase: Benefits team must reconcile enrollment data with compensation budgets to calculate total cost of employment.

step.label: Analyze procurement workforce spend patterns
step.description: Examine historical workforce-related procurement and contingent labor expenses to identify cost optimization opportunities in compensation structures.
step.useCase: Procurement and Finance collaborate to align workforce compensation with vendor management and contingent labor budgets.

step.label: Cross-reference invoice and material procurement costs
step.description: Correlate current invoice and procurement expenses with workforce allocation to understand overhead absorption and job costing implications.
step.useCase: Controllers need to map labor costs against material procurement to refine product profitability and project margin analysis.

step.label: Evaluate manufacturing impact and engineering labor allocation
step.description: Review engineering change orders and product development initiatives to assess labor utilization and compensation adjustments for technical staff.
step.useCase: Manufacturing and Engineering leadership must align compensation for staff impacted by product changes and new initiatives.

step.label: Monitor workplace safety incidents affecting compensation
step.description: Identify safety-related incidents and hazardous conditions that may trigger compensation adjustments, hazard pay, or benefit changes.
step.useCase: Safety and HR teams use incident data to adjust compensation for hazardous roles and validate workers' compensation eligibility.

step.label: Optimize production scheduling against workforce capacity
step.description: Align production orders and machine scheduling with workforce availability and shift planning to ensure compensation accurately reflects actual labor deployment.
step.useCase: Operations and Payroll teams coordinate to ensure compensation reflects scheduled labor hours and production demands.
